description: This file defines the class NonSeekableStreamDecodingEventStreamIterator, which extends DecodingEventStreamIterator. It provides functionality to parse and iterate over decoding event streams from a non-seekable input stream, including checksum validation and event parsing logic.

classes.name: NonSeekableStreamDecodingEventStreamIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for parsing decoding events from a non-seekable stream, with checksum validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a non-seekable stream and verifies the stream is not seekable.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses a decoding event from the stream, verifies checksum, and returns the event array.

methods.name: readAndHashBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream, updates the hash context, and returns the bytes.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the next event by parsing it.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next event, reading from the stream and parsing it.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the stream has more data for iteration.
